VEHICLE BRAND

Ferrari services in Riyadh

Independent Ferrari care in Riyadh: scheduled maintenance, diagnostics and brake care, with paint repair where Rosso and special finishes are matched to the actual car.

  1. Home
  2. Car Brands
  3. Ferrari

Ferraris in Riyadh live a particular life: low annual mileage, hard heat, and owners for whom originality and documentation matter as much as condition. Time-based service items age even when the odometer barely moves — fluids, belts where fitted, tyres and seals do not read the mileage. QSC services Ferrari models on that honest basis as an independent workshop, and handles stone-chip, scratch and panel paintwork at the painting facility, where a Rosso Corsa that has seen five Saudi summers is matched to the car it is today — not to a factory chip chart.

Ferrari care at QSC centres on the realities of low-mileage, high-heat ownership: annual-style servicing driven by time and condition, fluid and belt items respected by calendar, battery maintenance and tyre age watched on cars that rest between drives, and pre-drive checks offered before seasonal use. Mechanical work is scoped conservatively with fault evidence first — these engines reward patience and punish parts-cannon approaches. On paint, rosso finishes and the marque's frequent stone-chip frontal damage are handled with measured matching and front-end refinishing that respects original textures, orange peel levels included.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

My Ferrari barely gets driven. Does it still need servicing?

Yes — time-based items age regardless of mileage, and a car that sits needs its own checks: battery condition, tyre flat-spotting, fluid age and seals. A periodic service keeps a low-mileage car genuinely healthy rather than just low-mileage.

Is QSC an authorized Ferrari service center?

No — QSC is an independent specialist servicing Ferrari vehicles to the manufacturer's schedules and procedures, with no claim of authorization or factory affiliation. The brand name describes the vehicles serviced, nothing more.

How do I book service for my Ferrari?

Call, send a WhatsApp message or use the booking form with Ferrari selected as the make — the right workshop's team (maintenance or painting) confirms the appointment with you directly.
